goal: Implement a generic database-native, access-scoped, bounded and deterministic list boundary over current immutable record heads without Content or Docara knowledge.

before_gap.diagnostic: persistent VersionedStorage has exact/current reads but no durable scoped current-record list contract

counterexamples: PersistentGlobalRoleQueryScopeProvider supports storage.record but rejects storage.record:inventory.widget
provider-added tenant filter fails when tenant visibility changes from public to protected
executor evidence names implementation 410ec36 instead of final handoff 70710de

tests: CAS update plus separate exact historical read
access, schema, filter, limit, cursor and projection negative controls
StorageServiceProvider explicit QueryScopeProvider binding and missing-binding fail-closed behavior
provider-only protected scope filtering and caller/provider trust separation
zero storage mutation on rejected queries
composer validate --strict and composer run quality:gate
rollback: Delete the isolated branch/worktree or revert its single package-local commit; there is no migration, accepted-pin change, runtime action or user-data mutation.
stop_conditions: write required in Specs or another package
public product contract must change outside storage.record_list
green test requires weaker Access, projection, cursor integrity or durability
live, data, secret or destructive boundary encountered
